series.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム SEED DESTINY

brands.ja: Figure-rise Mechanics[フィギュアライズメカニクス]

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム SEED DESTINY』よりラクスのハロがFigure-rise Mechanicsにラインアップ！
description.en: Lacus' Haro from "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY" is now available in Figure-rise Mechanics!

description.ja: • 手足を引き出すギミックで、元気でかわいらしいハロを表現！手のひらにのる直径80mm。
description.en: • A gimmick that pulls out limbs to create a lively and cute halo! 80mm in diameter that fits in the palm of your hand.

description.ja: • 瞳にはクリアパーツを使用し、別売りLEDユニットで光らせることができる！
description.en: • Clear parts are used for the eyes, which can be illuminated with an optional LED unit!

description.ja: • 目のパーツは可動式で、ノーマル、つり目、たれ目、と表情豊かにディスプレイ可能！
description.en: • The eye parts are movable and can be displayed in a variety of expressive ways, including normal, slanted, and drooping eyes!

description.ja: • 内部構造は一部新規造形にて再現。内部メカが見える状態でディスプレイできるクリア外装付属！
description.en: • The internal structure is partially reproduced with new modeling. Comes with a clear exterior that allows you to display the internal mechanism clearly!

accessories.ja: スケルトンボディパーツ×1
